fluff.overview: ComStar organized its military forces around a combined-arms doctrine that valued infantry as an essential element of the Level I through Level VI command structure, with conventional platoons serving alongside BattleMechs, armor, and aerospace assets at every echelon. Mechanized wheeled platoons use wheeled APCs that provide good road speed and adequate armor protection for the infantry squad carried inside. Wheeled transport is cheaper to maintain than tracked or hover alternatives, making these formations a cost-effective choice for garrison duty on developed worlds with solid road infrastructure. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
